assessment: This study describes a novel mechanism by which ARP5 interacts with the master transcription factor MYOD to antagonize its function and thereby the myogenic gene expression program. ARP5 is up-regulated in rhabdomyosarcoma cells and appears to inhibit MYOD function as its depletion partially restores the myogenic program in the tumour cells. ARP5 is therefore a novel regulator of myogenesis in both normal and pathological contexts.
